_comment: DMG layout config. Consumed by the hdiutil-driven build step in the Makefile and .github/workflows/release.yml. Kept as JSON (rather than a shell script) so a future dmgbuild migration is a drop-in: the same keys map to dmgbuild's settings.py keys.
title: plex-renamer

contents._comment: GUI .app bundle produced by PyInstaller's BUNDLE step.
CLI one-folder bundle. Included so power users can drop the CLI binary onto their PATH alongside running the GUI.

_post_install_note: The .dmg is unsigned and ad-hoc. macOS Gatekeeper will require the user to right-click -> Open the first time. Code signing / notarization is explicitly out of scope for the first release per INVARIANTS.md.
